description: This file defines the API routes for managing notes in a RESTful web service. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching notes, using FastAPI framework. It also sets up dependencies to a notes service.

methods.name: NotesService _service()
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of NotesService with resolved dependencies.

methods.name: Note create_note(payload: NoteCreate)
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new note.

methods.name: NoteListResponse list_notes( limit: int = Query(200, ge=1, le=500, description="Max number of notes to return."), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Offset for pagination."), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list notes with pagination.

methods.name: Note get_note(note_id: int)
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a specific note by id.

methods.name: Note update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate)
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing note by id.

methods.name: None delete_note(note_id: int)
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a note by id.

methods.name: NoteListResponse search_notes( q: str = Query(..., min_length=1, max_length=200, description="Search query."), limit: int = Query(200, ge=1, le=500, description="Max number of notes to return."), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Offset for pagination."), )
methods.description: Endpoint to search for notes by query substring.

search-terms: Create, list, get, update, delete notes

ctags.name: list_notes
ctags.signature: ( limit: int = Query(200, ge=1, le=500, description="Max number of notes to return."), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Offset for pagination."), )

ctags.signature: ( q: str = Query(..., min_length=1, max_length=200, description="Search query."), limit: int = Query(200, ge=1, le=500, description="Max number of notes to return."), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Offset for pagination."), )
